items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE texture component of a NEW weathered RED-BRICK WALL variant for Chinese 2D 1990s coastal survival game 潮汐线. Reference image is existing in-game wall geometry and pixel-art STYLE ONLY; preserve its 75-degree high-angle orthographic camera convention, fixed upper-left light and restrained small-pixel clusters. New wall material must be visibly different from the existing pale limestone/gray-green plaster wall: subdued dusty terracotta and grey-brown brick, grey-beige mortar, irregular residual old pale plaster and dark damp weathering, never saturated orange or bright red. Crisp deliberate LOW-RESOLUTION PIXEL ART, 8–16 muted colors, no photorealism or soft airbrush. This image is ONLY ONE FULL-BLEED OPAQUE TEXTURE SURFACE, not an isolated wall chunk, not an entire building, not a collage. Fill the canvas edge-to-edge with the material; no margins, transparent background, bevel around tile, decorative border, cast shadow, perspective scene, floor, objects, plants, grass, writing, signs or UI. SURFACE: TOP CAP viewed straight from above, logical 32x32 tile. Dusty light warm red-brown / pale terracotta fired-brick top surface, very worn quiet broad brick crowns and a few shallow grey-beige mortar joins; about two staggered brick courses across the square. Top planes brighter than wall front, base colors around #ad927c and #a48570 with a few darker brick chips #896f5c. Very thin traces of old grey-beige mortar/capping material in crevices, not a completely plastered beige slab. Keep top cap calm and broad, not dense noisy gravel or tiny mosaic. No visible vertical wall face in this component. Seamlessly tile both horizontally and vertically: no strong edge seams, edge brightness matches, bricks crossing edges continue naturally. Upper-left subtle highlight only, flat orthographic material. Square canvas.
